intro: 12 個稅務情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: It took my accountant some time to complete the calculations on my income tax.
ex.zh: 我的會計師花了一些時間才算完我的所得稅。

ex.en: According to my calculations, I'll owe less money on my income taxes this year.
ex.zh: 根據我的計算,我今年要繳的所得稅會比較少。

ex.en: The deadline for paying this year's taxes is just two weeks away.
ex.zh: 今年繳稅的截止期限只剩兩週了。

ex.en: My best work is done with strict deadlines.
ex.zh: 在嚴格的期限下,我能做出最好的成果。

note: meet a deadline 趕上期限;miss a deadline 錯過期限

ex.en: If you file your taxes late, you will have to pay a fine.
ex.zh: 如果你逾期報稅,就得繳罰款。

ex.en: If you believe the tax preparer gave you incorrect information, you should file a complaint.
ex.zh: 如果你認為報稅代理人給了你錯誤的資訊,你應該提出申訴。

note: file a lawsuit 提起訴訟;名詞為「文件、檔案」
file taxes 報稅;file a complaint 提出申訴

ex.en: I usually ask someone to help me fill out my tax form.
ex.zh: 我通常會請人幫我填寫報稅表格。

ex.en: Don't forget to sign the tax form after you have filled it out.
ex.zh: 填好報稅表後別忘了簽名。

note: 代名詞要放中間:fill it out

ex.en: Bruce gave up paying an accountant to prepare his tax return and now does it himself.
ex.zh: 布魯斯不再花錢請會計師幫他準備報稅,現在都自己來。

ex.en: Ms. Gomez gave up hope that she would ever receive a large tax refund.
ex.zh: 戈梅茲女士已經不再指望能拿到一大筆退稅。

note: give up + V-ing 放棄做某事

ex.en: We opened a joint bank account five years ago.
ex.zh: 我們五年前開了一個聯名銀行帳戶。

ex.en: The couple no longer files joint tax returns.
ex.zh: 這對夫妻不再合併申報所得稅了。

note: joint account 聯名帳戶;joint venture 合資企業

ex.en: People are surprised to discover that they owe money in income taxes at the end of the year.
ex.zh: 人們到了年底才驚訝地發現自己還欠所得稅。

ex.en: As the business grew, the owner paid back loans and owed less money.
ex.zh: 隨著事業成長,老闆還清了貸款,欠的錢也變少了。

note: owe sb sth 欠某人某物;owe A to B 把 A 歸功於 B

ex.en: Anyone who pays less than they should in taxes will face a penalty.
ex.zh: 任何少繳稅的人都會面臨罰款。

ex.en: Penalties are imposed to discourage underpayment of taxes.
ex.zh: 祭出罰則是為了遏止少繳稅款。

ex.en: Income tax preparation can take a long time.
ex.zh: 準備所得稅申報可能要花很長的時間。

ex.en: You should do some preparation on your own before hiring an accountant to work on your taxes.
ex.zh: 在請會計師處理稅務之前,你應該自己先做些準備。

note: in preparation for 為⋯做準備

ex.en: With the tax refund, we bought two plane tickets.
ex.zh: 我們用退稅買了兩張機票。

ex.en: The government will refund any money that you overpaid.
ex.zh: 政府會退還你多繳的任何款項。

note: tax refund 退稅;full refund 全額退款

ex.en: You can claim your spouse as a dependent on your tax return if he doesn't earn an income.
ex.zh: 如果你的配偶沒有收入,你可以在報稅時把他列為扶養親屬。

ex.en: My spouse prepares the tax return for both of us.
ex.zh: 我的配偶幫我們兩個人準備所得稅申報。

note: tax return 所得稅申報表;income 收入

ex.en: My employer withholds money from each paycheck to apply toward my income taxes.
ex.zh: 我的雇主每次發薪都會預扣一筆錢,用來繳我的所得稅。

ex.en: Do not withhold information from your accountant, or he won't be able to prepare your taxes correctly.
ex.zh: 不要對你的會計師隱瞞資訊,否則他沒辦法正確地幫你報稅。

note: withhold A from B 對 B 扣留/隱瞞 A
